about_page.title: About Raah
about_page.what_text: What goes in: terrain from a 30 m elevation model, live and forecast rain from five stations along the road, 309 road-blocking landslides mapped after the 2022 monsoon, and reports from drivers checked by officials.
about_page.how_text1: We tested it on road sections it had never seen. It ranks a landslide-prone section above a calmer one in about 3 out of 4 comparisons.
about_page.how_text2: It is an estimate. It can miss events and it can raise false alarms. Follow BRO and police instructions.
